
### layers 

<table>
<tr><td> application</td><td>HTTP, SSH, SMTP, ...</td><td>application-defined meanings</td></tr>
<tr><td> transport</td><td>TCP, UDP, ...</td><td>reach correct program,  reliablity/streams</td></tr>
<tr><td> network</td><td>IPv4, IPv6, ...</td><td>reach correct machine (across networks)</td></tr>
<tr><td> link</td><td>Ethernet, Wi-Fi, ...</td><td>coordinate shared wire/radio</td></tr>
<tr><td> physical</td><td>...</td><td>encode bits for wire/radio</td></tr>
<tr><td></td></tr>
</table>
